New imaging demonstrating progressive orbital roof scalloping and medial wall displacement indicates orbital leukemic infiltration, while a CSF blast count of 1400×10^6/L with elevated opening pressure confirms leptomeningeal involvement. These findings directly support the leukemic relapse hypothesis and refute IIH, since the elevated CSF pressure is explained by meningeal leukemic infiltration rather than primary idiopathic intracranial hypertension. Orbital pseudotumor/infection is also excluded by the destructive bony changes and CSF blasts. With strong supporting evidence and no refuting evidence, the diagnosis is confidently established as leukemic orbital/CNS relapse.
